name: elections26
description: Knesset 26 elections dashboard — verifiable candidate lists, parliamentary records and poll projections

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/schema packages/data packages/db packages/ingest && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.vercel-build: npx tsx scripts/validate.ts && npx tsx scripts/publish-db.ts --from-build && npm run build -w apps/web
